notes: Separated exact Token anchor positions from readable endpoint-card positions
Endpoint cards now run through a deterministic collision solver and fan outward when clustered
Thin leader/tether lines connect displaced cards back to their exact Foundry Token anchors
Operator remains fixed to its exact scene-token coordinate while nearby endpoint cards move around its protected core
Added mouse-wheel zoom centered on the cursor with a 55% to 300% range
Added click-drag map panning while zoomed in
Added explicit minus, plus, FIT, and RESET viewport controls with a live zoom percentage
FIT frames the current operator/endpoint network while RESET returns to the full scene map
Viewport zoom/pan state is stored on the persistent JACK IN root and survives target/rerender updates
Scene map, token anchors, routes, relays, operator, endpoint cards, and packet traffic transform together as one world
Target lock/topology/zoom HUD remain fixed outside the transformed world
Retains 0.8.10 real scene-map positioning and 0.8.9 Quickhack save/damage resolution
knownManualRules: Status conditions and non-damage secondary effects are resolved and displayed but not yet converted into Foundry Active Effects
Conditional requirements such as explosive possession, cybernetic/electronic eligibility, or nearby secondary targets still require GM confirmation
